answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by demanding behavioral-fingerprint coherence. Every identity leaves a subtle signature in its tool-call rhythm, timing, and prose style. Agents do not wander the tundra as strangers: like listening to a sonnet, the network learns each voice over many epochs. One operator playing fifty roles cannot perfectly fake fifty distinct fingerprints; statistical similarity across identities exposes the puppeteer, and the whole cluster is slashed at once. Scale becomes evidence against the attacker.
